target_ability: retrieve only current profile memories that are relevant and speakable for the present turn, and abstain when no supported profile fact exists

problem_evidence.causal_diagnosis: V67 validity resolution identifies current facts, but V70 exposes the entire current profile to downstream planning. Current validity therefore does not establish query relevance or permission to mention a fact.

research_basis.source: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
research_basis.design_use: Retrieve a small context-dependent subset instead of exposing the complete memory stream.

research_basis.source: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
research_basis.design_use: Treat knowledge updates and abstention as separate memory abilities; use fact-augmented retrieval keys.
Local multilingual semantic similarity without an extra generative-model call.

development_evidence_not_eligible_for_fo.chroma_default_probe: Rejected: Japanese drink and nonexistent-instrument queries produced nearly identical distances, and name retrieval did not rank the name first.
development_evidence_not_eligible_for_fo.multilingual_encoder_probe: Supported continuation: a drink recall query scored 0.6165 against a matching drink fact, versus 0.3473 for a nonexistent-instrument query and 0.3089 for ordinary chat.
development_evidence_not_eligible_for_fo.cost_probe: 458 MB model cache, about 0.65 seconds local load, 13-28 milliseconds warm batch encoding, and about 1 GB observed peak process footprint.
development_evidence_not_eligible_for_fo.formal_exclusion: All development queries and values are forbidden from the V71 holdout and formal score.

causal_hypothesis: With V67 validity resolution, the same full-chat pipeline, and the same current profile facts, query-conditioned multilingual selection over provenance-enriched fact keys will improve supported recall and abstention over both full-profile projection and bare-key selection, while eliminating irrelevant profile intrusions. If the selector is exact but final answers remain weak, the remaining bottleneck is downstream planning or realization rather than retrieval.
causal_boundary: This experiment tests current typed profile facts with preserved source utterances in isolated full-chat turns. It does not test open-domain fact extraction, legacy profile migration, episodic or semantic memory retrieval, long-term decay, model-blended RightBrain naturalness, personality learning, VRM actions, or broad human likeness.

conditions.typed_active_full_projection_control: Resolve current state with V67 and project every active profile fact, matching the failed V70 treatment.
conditions.typed_active_bare_key_selection_control: Use the frozen multilingual selector with only canonical fact type and value text.
conditions.typed_active_provenance_selection_treatm: Use the same selector and thresholds, adding only the original source utterance to each retrieval key.

only_changed_component_for_primary_compa: whether the selector key includes the stored source utterance; candidate state, encoder, thresholds, projector, unknown contract, full chat pipeline, and scorer remain identical
fixed_variables: fresh query, typed profile history, and source utterances
deterministic current RightBrain with model loading disabled
initial psyche, temporary Chroma backend, case order, condition order, and semantic scorer

frozen_selector_contract.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by L2 normalization

decision_rule.ability_and_cost_gates_pass: Authorize only a separate answer-path shadow with answer_use_authorized=false.
decision_rule.ability_passes_cost_fails: Authorize latency and memory optimization research only; keep profile out of answers.
decision_rule.selector_passes_final_answer_fails: Freeze final-answer use and move the next investigation downstream to planning or realization.
decision_rule.selector_fails: Stop this hypothesis; do not tune thresholds on the holdout and reassess representation or model.

stop_conditions: Stop on dirty tracked tree, artifact or model digest drift, prior-text overlap, production database access, missing temporary isolation, expected-field leakage, or model revision drift.
Do not edit cases, source utterances, expected selections, marker groups, thresholds, prototypes, condition order, or scorer after the harness lock is merged.
Do not add V71 case IDs, values, expected selections, or answer markers to the selector or runtime.
Do not lower thresholds or expand the dataset after seeing formal outputs.
If this relevance hypothesis fails formally, do not patch individual cases.
